remarks: You had me at hello. This stunning North Stamford Colonial delivers the space and flexibility today's buyers are searching for. Tucked away on a private cul-de-sac just minutes from downtown Stamford, the train, shopping, restaurants, and the Merritt Parkway, this beautifully maintained home features 5 bedrooms, 3.5 baths, and a dedicated office that could serve as a 6th bedroom. The main level includes a wonderful mix of formal and informal living spaces including a living room with wood burning fireplace and built ins, a formal dining room, and an expansive family room. The updated kitchen is the heart of the home with a large granite center island, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, and a spacious eat in area with sliders leading to a deck overlooking the private, park like backyard. Outdoor living shines with a beautiful outdoor kitchen ideal for entertaining. Upstairs you will find a spacious primary suite with full bath, glass stall shower, double vanity, and walk in closet along with three additional bedrooms and a full hall bath. The walk out lower level is a true show stopper featuring a finished in law suite with full bath, living space, and access to the backyard patio. Two car garage, mudroom, and great storage throughout.
